derived_results.claim: The r89 worst C_tt parameter cell is strictly positive under a coarse 128x128 70-digit Decimal FLOOR/CEILING monotone-box lower enclosure at rho=0.55441744. The unnormalized lower sum is 0.390193496035455157818646591897155943619948674549179262818559. The omitted q normalizer is strictly positive, so the sign conclusion is invariant.

An independent 60-dps mpmath 180x180 recomputation gives an unnormalized lower sum 3.8841601931904497458911861172078338823760570547834; float64 with the same formulas gives 3.884160193190475, an absolute gap about 2.49e-14.

Independent Gauss-Jacobi quadrature in the exact transformed-q coordinates refines the active-pair equalization root to rho approximately 0.5544128274647656. Orders 128,160,192,256 all agree to displayed precision; the root is about 4.6125e-6 below the old screen value 0.55441744.

At 180x180 engineering resolution, the worst-cell lower enclosure remains strongly positive at rho_root-1e-8, rho_root, and rho_root+1e-8: approximately 3.8842309160, 3.8842307631, and 3.8842306101 respectively.

negative_or_scope_evidence: The directed Decimal result is at the same trusted-machine arithmetic standard as r98, not proof-assistant/MPFI grade; Python Decimal and custom high-precision transcendental bracketing remain trusted components.
Only the r89 worst C_tt parameter cell has been directed-certified in this invocation. Global C_tt positivity over the 16x16 parameter grid remains open.
The refined rho value is still an engineering quadrature root, not a directed certified interval; four active-corner C(theta)=1 equalities remain open.

The q normalization constant was omitted from the lower-sum numerics because it is strictly positive; therefore magnitudes are not directly comparable to r89's normalized lower sum, but sign conclusions are valid.
All results remain restricted to the standardized frozen m=32 NIG/four-corner iid Gaussian setup.

candidate_new.mechanism: Before paying the 260x260 cost on every parameter cell, use a coarse directed monotone-box enclosure to establish a robust sign margin on the empirically worst cell. Pair that with a separately converged active-pair rho root so the next global cover can focus only on genuinely difficult parameter regions and a narrow rho transport interval.
